notes: P01 and P02 share one host/session; a failure blocks every following slot.

C02 requires a retained live compiler handle plus actual csc.dll command-line evidence; a missed compiler window is NOT_OBSERVED, not PASS.
Expected injected rejection counts PASS only when all strict state assertions pass.
Project services/PTY isolation is real; Project preparation authority is a fixture. Full Project UI/runtime selection is outside this evidence.
No old adapter result is used as Policy B acceptance; all Learning execution uses staged PolicySession.
Previous NOT_OBSERVED results and R1-R5 evidence are immutable. No retries until PASS. P02 and specified shutdown/workspace retries are planned scenario steps.
